Are you passionate about creating robust and scalable software solutions?
Join us as a Full Stack Developer and play a key role in building impactful applications. We’re looking for someone with a strong technical background, problem-solving mindset, and collaborative attitude to help shape our innovative projects.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and implement scalable software applications using C# and .NET Core.
Build and optimize Web APIs with a focus on best practices.
Work with JavaScript, jQuery, and other front-end technologies to deliver seamless user experiences.
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code with a focus on performance and scalability.
Collaborate with developers, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver new features and enhancements.
Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade the software to ensure optimal functionality.
Lead by example, providing technical guidance and mentorship to the team.
Qualifications
Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Experience: 2 years of hands-on experience in software development, including front-end and back-end work.
Technical Skills:
Strong expertise in C#, .NET Core, MVC, and Microservices architecture.
Proficiency in JavaScript, jQuery, and other front-end frameworks.
Knowledge of database management and integration.
Soft Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities.
A collaborative team player with a proactive attitude.
Why Join Us?
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.
Performance bonuses based on your contributions and team achievements.
The opportunity to work on industry-leading projects.
Location: This is a full-time, onsite role based in Karachi.

About Us
Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.
Higharc is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead the technical architecture and delivery of our Home Design Experience application, a browser-based 3D tool that lets anyone design a home. You’ll report to the VP of Engineering and serve as the primary technical partner to the team’s product/UX lead.
As the HDE team’s most experienced engineer, you’ll make consequential technical decisions, write production code, and help other engineers deliver. Your immediate focus will be getting the application into customers’ hands. Along the way, you’ll partner with our platform team to establish shared foundations and patterns that other Higharc applications can reuse.
What You'll Do
You’ll need to move fast, make good calls under ambiguity, and turn rough product ideas into working software that customers can pick up and use without a manual. You'll work across the primary UI as well as AI-supported and agentic experiences, and you'll partner with the other staff-level engineers at Higharc to give the company's technical strategy real shape.
Expect to:
Rapidly prototype new home design workflows and turn the ones that land into customer-ready software
Lead development of interactive 3D home design workflows, connecting the application UI, design data, and real-time 3D scene into a responsive experience. Build AI-supported and agentic interactions that help users design their homes.
Own application architecture and technical delivery from early prototypes through production. Make decisions across the frontend, application state, and service integration, including performance, reliability, and testing.
Be an independent technical partner to the product/UX lead: challenge assumptions, identify risks early, propose alternatives, and help decide what to build next.
Turn ambiguous goals into concrete implementation plans, resolve technical unknowns through working code, and implement the critical pieces yourself to keep delivery moving.
Partner with the platform team to use and improve shared application foundations. Identify which patterns should be reused across Higharc and help implement and document them, keeping immediate product delivery central to those decisions.
Help less experienced engineers take ownership through pairing, code review, and clear technical guidance. Establish patterns they can confidently extend.
About You
You've shipped products that solve genuinely hard problems in a way that feels effortless to the end user, and you know how much unglamorous work sits behind that kind of simplicity. You're comfortable being the most senior engineer in the room without needing everything decided before you start building, and you know how to narrow scope, ship useful increments, and make technical decisions that support continued delivery.
You have:
A track record of personally architecting, building, and shipping substantial web applications, with responsibility for technical decisions from initial implementation through production use.
Deep hands-on experience with TypeScript, React, and modern web application architecture, including application state, API integration, performance, and maintainability.
A strong plus: hands-on experience with Three.js and browser-based 3D applications, especially design or CAD tools. You’ll be helping people design homes in 3D, so experience making complex spatial interactions intuitive is particularly valuable.
Genuine enthusiasm for AI-forward development and for building AI-supported or agentic product experiences
Experience making technical decisions independently in partnership with a product or design lead. You can explain tradeoffs, challenge a proposed approach constructively, and commit to a path forward.
Sound judgment about what to build for the immediate product and what to generalize for reuse, with experience collaborating across application and platform teams.
Experience helping less experienced engineers deliver through implementation, mentoring, and technical guidance.
A growth mindset and real ease with ambiguity, on a team and product area that's still being defined
Strong instincts for design and craft, even though you're not the designer on the team
Working at Higharc
Remote work and travel: Our company is entirely remote, and has been since we were founded in 2018. Remote work means more time with family, less time commuting, and the flexibility to blend work and life. We value in-person collaboration and asynchronous deep-work time, which is why we schedule regular team meet-ups in our hubs across the US and, depending on the role, prioritize hiring in those hubs. If your role requires frequent travel beyond pre-scheduled team meet ups, we will represent that to the best of our ability as early as possible in the interview process.
Compensation and benefits: Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast-growing, well-funded company. We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. You'll also have access to other big-company benefits such like short and long-term disability plans and a 401K. We also provide a stipend to create the ideal home office and support ongoing L&D.
Please note: we are seeing an uptick of fraudulent recruiting activity claiming to be associated with Higharc. All communication and outreach from our in-house team will come from an @higharc.com email address.

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.
We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.
Why You’ll Love This Role
As a Backend Engineer at Cribl, you will help set the technical direction for Core Platform by working closely with an existing team of awesome engineers and product managers to help identify, design, develop, and deliver products that delight our customers. Additionally, you will be empowered to influence our internal tools, technologies, and processes as we continue to grow. This role is equal parts research and development. If you enjoy the challenges of building scalable, robust, and high performing distributed systems which process large data sets in real time, this position may be right for you. In this role, you will join a team of skilled engineers committed to shipping the highest quality software and ensuring our customers’ satisfaction. This is a fully remote role and Cribl is a remote first company. Our culture embraces the diversity of team members spread all across the globe.
As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…
Develop software for projects and features with an emphasis on backend systems and APIs responsible for ingesting, processing, and routing data
Design, develop, test, and maintain clear, concise, and robust code that produces the desired outcomes for our customers
Partner with a cross functional team of engineers, designers, and product managers to translate feature specifications into product designs and implementable code
Ensure product features are working as expected by creating rich test plans paired with comprehensive automated tests
Have end-to-end ownership of the software you develop, regularly participating in your team’s on-call/support rotation
Be a driver, take the initiative to help the larger team reach desired outcomes even if it’s outside your job description
This position will require stand-by, on-call, or off-hours duties
If You’ve Got It - We Want It
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Solid CS fundamentals from coursework or experience: data structures, algorithms, basic networking and operating systems concepts, and an interest in distributed systems and scalability principles
Demonstrated experience building products that leverage large scale data sets (Node.js/Typescript)
Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and scalability principles.
Knowledge of systems level debugging, networking, performance profiling and tuning.
Enjoy learning new technologies and ability to understand how to root cause complex problems
Experience with Agile processes and rapid iterative development
Strong sense of ownership with focus on high quality and high performing deliverables
Experience developing software or services for cloud based platforms
Applicants must be able to comply with U.S. government security requirements for access to FedRAMP-authorized systems, which may include U.S. citizenship
The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.
In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.
Base Salary Range
$150,000—$175,000 USD
Bring Your Whole Self
Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you’ll ever meet at cribl.io/about-us.

As an hourly paid, fully remote Rust Engineer for AI Data Training, you will review AI-generated Rust code and explanations or generate your own, evaluate the reasoning quality and step-by-step problem-solving, and provide expert feedback that helps models produce answers that are accurate, logical, and clearly explained. You will assess solutions for correctness, safety, and adherence to the prompt; identify errors in ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, or algorithmic reasoning; fact-check information; write high-quality explanations and model solutions that demonstrate idiomatic Rust patterns; and rate and compare multiple AI responses based on correctness and reasoning quality. This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate that provides AI training data for many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation model labs. Your work will directly help improve the world’s premier AI models while giving you the flexibility of impactful, detail-oriented remote contract work.
Important
There is no immediate project for this role; however, if qualified, you will be among the first experts we reach out to when relevant opportunities arise. This will also provide you with access to future projects available through our expert network.
Key Responsibilities
Develop AI Training Content: Create detailed prompts in various topics and responses to guide AI learning, ensuring the models reflect a comprehensive understanding of diverse subjects.
Optimize AI Performance: Evaluate and rank AI responses to enhance the model's accuracy, fluency, and contextual relevance.
Ensure Model Integrity: Test AI models for potential inaccuracies or biases, validating their reliability across use cases.
Your Profile
1–2+ years of professional Rust development experience in backend, CLI, or systems-focused projects.
Strong understanding of Rust’s ownership, borrowing, and lifetime model, with the ability to reason clearly about aliasing and data races.
Solid software engineering experience in at least one of backend services, command-line tools, or systems programming using Rust.
Ability to evaluate safe, idiomatic Rust code, including appropriate use of traits, generics, pattern matching, and error handling.
Significant experience using LLMs or AI coding assistants while programming, combined with a disciplined approach to validating their output.
Excellent English writing skills, capable of producing precise, structured, and pedagogical technical explanations.
Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related technical field.
Previous experience with AI data training, code review at scale, or evaluation of AI-generated technical content is strongly preferred; Minimum C1 English proficiency and an extremely detail-oriented working style are required.
Highly preferred: experience with Tokio, Actix, Serde, and async Rust patterns in production or advanced side projects.
Preferred: competitive programming experience, contributions to Rust open-source ecosystems, and demonstrated ability to reason about performance, concurrency, and correctness in Rust code.

As a TypeScript Engineer, you will work remotely on an hourly paid basis reviewing AI-generated TypeScript code snippets, design proposals, and technical explanations, as well as generating your own high-quality content and reference solutions. You will evaluate step-by-step reasoning and problem-solving, checking solutions for correctness, clarity, and adherence to the prompt; identify errors in logic, type modeling, or architectural thinking; fact-check technical information; craft clear explanations and model solutions that demonstrate correct approaches; and rate and compare multiple AI responses based on their reasoning quality and implementation soundness. In this role, your TypeScript expertise directly helps improve the world’s premier AI models used by engineers and developers everywhere.
Important
There is no immediate project for this role; however, if qualified, you will be among the first experts we reach out to when relevant opportunities arise. This will also provide you with access to future projects available through our expert network.
Key Responsibilities
Develop AI Training Content: Create detailed prompts in various topics and responses to guide AI learning, ensuring the models reflect a comprehensive understanding of diverse subjects.
Optimize AI Performance: Evaluate and rank AI responses to enhance the model's accuracy, fluency, and contextual relevance.
Ensure Model Integrity: Test AI models for potential inaccuracies or biases, validating their reliability across use cases.

2+ years professional TypeScript experience.
Expertise in TypeScript features, including advanced type manipulation, generics, interfaces, and utility types.
Strong proficiency with a major frontend framework (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue.js) or backend runtime (e.g., Node.js with Express or NestJS).
Solid understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP), functional programming concepts, and common software design patterns.
Experience with Git and standard version control workflows (branching, merging, pull requests).
Familiarity with modern build tools (e.g., Webpack, Vite, Babel).
Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.
Minimum C1 English proficiency (written and spoken), with strong ability to follow detailed technical guidelines.
Good to have: Merged PRs in TypeScript-based open-source projects.
Good to have: Competitive programming experience, experience reviewing typed API layers, DTOs, or schema-driven designs, and previous exposure to AI data training or annotation projects.

About the role:
We’re looking for a software engineer who is also interested in crypto markets and comfortable participating in day trading as part of the role.
You’ll work with us to research trading strategies, analyze market data, and build algorithms that can be tested and improved over time. A major part of the work will be studying 10 years or more of historical data where available , identifying patterns, testing hypotheses, and using evidence to evaluate trading ideas.
This is one integrated role: you’ll contribute to both the trading work and the software behind it. We’re open to students, recent graduates, and experienced candidates who can show strong technical and analytical skills alongside genuine crypto trading experience.
We value practical problem-solving. You should be comfortable finding useful exchanges, APIs, datasets, libraries, open-source projects, and existing tools, then connecting them into a working system. The goal is to build a stable crypto trading algorithm by assembling and improving what already works—not rebuilding every component from scratch.
What you’ll do
Participate in crypto market research and day-trading activity.
Analyze long-term historical market data, including 10 years or more where reliable data is available.
Collect, clean, validate, and analyze data from crypto exchanges and other relevant sources.
Use data analysis and critical thinking to identify patterns, test hypotheses, and assess whether a strategy has evidence behind it.
Study price action, market behavior, and trading strategies, and help translate useful ideas into testable rules.
Develop Python tools and services for data collection, analysis, and automation.
Work with exchange APIs, libraries, and other data sources; use scripting or automation where appropriate.
Research technical indicators and formulas using reliable references, open-source tools, and AI assistants such as Claude.
Verify formulas and AI-generated code before using them in analysis or trading systems.
Connect existing tools and services to fill gaps in the trading workflow.
Build and improve backtesting, monitoring, alerting, and execution components.
Test strategies with historical data and simulated trading, then help evaluate live trading under defined risk limits.
Document your methods, assumptions, results, and limitations so the team can make data-informed decisions.
What we’re looking for
Strong interest in cryptocurrency markets and demonstrable experience buying, selling, or day trading crypto.
Comfort participating in day-trading research and activity as well as software development.
Strong data analysis and critical analysis skills, with the ability to question assumptions and interpret results carefully.
Working knowledge of Python, including writing scripts for data collection, analysis, and automation.
Experience using APIs, preferably exchange APIs, and handling structured data such as JSON.
Ability to work with historical and time-series data and to evaluate trading ideas using evidence.
Familiarity with appropriate tools for data-driven analysis, such as pandas, NumPy, SQL, notebooks, statistical methods, or visualization tools.
Ability to research indicators, understand the logic behind them, and translate ideas into code.
A practical mindset: you look for suitable existing tools and libraries before building a replacement.
Good communication skills and the ability to explain your reasoning, trading ideas, and technical decisions.
Curiosity, discipline, and a willingness to learn from experiments that do not produce the expected result.
Helpful experience
Familiarity with crypto exchanges, market-data feeds, order types, and trading dashboards.
Experience analyzing large datasets, historical price data, or time-series data.
Exposure to backtesting, quantitative analysis, algorithmic trading, or risk management.
Experience with tools such as Cursor, Claude, or other AI coding assistants.
Contributions to relevant open-source projects or personal trading, data analysis, or software projects.
Who should apply
You do not need a particular degree or a long employment history. Students, recent graduates, self-taught developers, and experienced professionals are all welcome to apply if they can demonstrate relevant skills and trading experience.
This role combines hands-on crypto market participation with software engineering and data analysis. If you are interested only in coding and are not comfortable engaging with day-trading activity, this role may not be the right fit.
How to apply
Please include your résumé or LinkedIn profile.

Introduction
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
Your Role And Responsibilities
As an Application Developer specializing in SAP ABAP HANA, you will design, develop, and support application solutions with a focus on the HANA version of Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP). You will work on designing, developing, and re-engineering highly complex application components, integrating software packages, programs, and reusable objects residing on multiple platforms.
Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include
Develop Application Solutions: Design, develop, and support application solutions with a focus on HANA version of ABAP, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and platforms.
Integrate Software Packages: Integrate software packages, programs, and reusable objects residing on multiple platforms, leveraging knowledge of SAP HANA Technical Concept and Architecture.
Re-engineer Application Components: Re-engineer highly complex application components to optimize performance, scalability, and reliability, utilizing ABAP Development Tools (ADT) and Code Performance Rules and Guidelines for SAP HANA.
Model Data using HANA Studio: Create data models using HANA Studio, adhering to best practices and ensuring data consistency and integrity.
Consume HANA Live Models: Consume HANA Live models to deliver real-time insights and analytics, leveraging knowledge of ADBC, Native SQL, and ABAP Core Data Services.
Required Technical And Professional Expertise
Exposure to SAP ABAP HANA: Experience working with HANA version of Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP), including designing, developing, and supporting application solutions.
Knowledge of SAP HANA Technical Concept and Architecture: Familiarity with SAP HANA Technical Concept and Architecture, including data modeling using HANA Studio and ABAP Development Tools (ADT).
Experience with Data Modeling: Exposure to data modeling using HANA Studio, adhering to best practices and ensuring data consistency and integrity.
Understanding of Code Performance Rules: Familiarity with Code Performance Rules and Guidelines for SAP HANA, including ADBC, Native SQL, and ABAP Core Data Services.
Integration Experience: Experience integrating software packages, programs, and reusable objects residing on multiple platforms.
Preferred Technical And Professional Experience
Working Knowledge of HANA Live: Familiarity with consuming HANA Live models to deliver real-time insights and analytics, leveraging knowledge of ADBC, Native SQL, and ABAP Core Data Services.
Exposure to Database Procedures: Understanding of database procedures, text search, and ALV on HANA, including data base procedures and HANA Live models consumption.
Familiarity with ABAP Core Data Services: Knowledge of ABAP Core Data Services, including data modeling and code performance optimization techniques.

I assumed AWS Local Zone in Lagos was the easy answer to the CBN localisation requirement. Then I sat down and read the documentation properly.

It isn't, at least not for the data layer.

There's no RDS in the Lagos Local Zone, so you'd be self-managing Postgres or MySQL on EC2. Also, Local Zones extend a parent Region (Lagos is linked to af-south-1), so EBS snapshots write to S3 in the parent Region by default. Local snapshots only work in Local Zones with S3 in-zone, and Lagos doesn't have that. So your backups end up in Cape Town.

Which leads to the bigger problem. There's no AWS Region in Nigeria. No Azure Region or Google Cloud Region either. If your payment database runs on a hyperscaler today, it's sitting in Ireland, Virginia or Cape Town — and so are your automated backups and your KMS keys.

The June circular requires payment transaction data generated in Nigeria to be stored and managed in Nigeria from 1 January 2027. That's under 90 days. For most teams, this isn't a settings change, because there's nowhere to point it at.

The harder question is what "𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐝 𝐢𝐧 𝐍𝐢𝐠𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐚" actually means in practice. Several law firms read it as covering the primary processing environment rather than just a copy held locally, which would mean backing up from a hyperscaler into Nigeria doesn't meet it. I put that question to Huawei Cloud directly and got the same answer, though they'd obviously have an interest in saying so.

I've been working out how Nigerian startups can meet these requirements without needing a large infrastructure team or building everything from scratch.

If you're working through this at a Nigerian fintech or building infrastructure for one, I'd be glad to compare notes.

XBOX is building a new kind of flywheel with games at the center.

The company announced XP this morning (a clever title)—a new division headed by Kayleen Walters focused on creating more on-ramps for fans to its beloved IP through film & television, consumer products, live events, and strategic partnerships.

Here are the four divisions:

* XBOX PICTURES: Bringing our worlds and characters to new audiences through film, television, and other forms of linear storytelling. 
* XBOX PRODUCTS: Creating products that are authentic to the fandom that allow fans to celebrate and express the franchises they love. 
* XBOX PLACES: Bringing communities together through live events, immersive experiences, attractions, broadcasts, and destinations. 
* XBOX PARTNERSHIPS: Working with creators, brands, and communities to develop new experiences, sponsorships, and brand partnerships.

The move—championed by Matthew Ball following an internal memo from Asha Sharma—is both elegant and strategic. It adopts the best strategies from Disney and Nintendo, both of whom understand that content is king. Where Disney’s flywheel was built strategically around film and television firs, Nintendo’s is game first.

With this move, XBOX is positioning itself to move beyond being a mere platform to owning its market position as both a publisher and steward of massive IP (from Minecraft to Halo and beyond).

I’m excited to see where this leads.

Game studio funding is back: Gardens Interactive has raised a $35M+ Series B, bringing total funding to over $70M before launching its flagship game.

Led by Lightspeed, the round includes Sequoia Capital, Index Ventures, Accel, Eric Schmidt’s Innovation Endeavors, the Nintendo family (Yamauchi No.10), the ZeniMax Media family (James Altman), and the founders of Slack and OpenAI's Sora.

By any measure, but certainly in 2026, that's an extraordinary vote of confidence and tier-1 syndicate for a pre-launch studio. What inspires that conviction while it seems all venture dollars chase automation?

A team creating a new genre around a simple and proven design principle: deepen human connections, and let the players be the fun.

Gardens calls it a “strandbox”: a social roleplaying world where chance encounters become adventures, players shape each other’s stories, and your actions leave something behind for whoever comes next.

From serial game-of-the-year creators behind Journey and Sky, the team blends indie creativity and beautiful art with an ambitious AAA live-ops platform bet on how games can create significant and long-lasting emotional encounters.

This one is deeply personal. I love Stephen, 🔔Chris, and Lexie like brothers. After serving on Gardens’ board for the past three years, I’m rejoining as a personal investor and advisor, doubling down with my own capital and time. To continue an extraordinary development journey that already brought so many wonderful once-strangers together.

I can’t wait for you all to play what they’re building.

Today, Supabase is announcing $150M in new funding, led by GIC, with CapitalG, IronArc Ventures, and Square Peg participating. We’re also welcoming Turso to Supabase.

The past year has been the fastest period of growth in Supabase’s history. We’re now adding more than 1M users and nearly 5M databases every month, and around 70% of new databases are being created by agents or AI-driven tools.

AI is changing the economics of software creation. More people can build software, developers can build dramatically more of it, and agents are increasingly building alongside them.

Our goal is to make Supabase the foundation for this agentic era. That means making it radically cheaper to start, while giving every application a clear path to scale.
That’s a big part of why we’re acquiring Turso.

As agents create more software, database demand will outpace the world’s current capacity. Turso has built an architecture that can handle vastly more small databases at a fraction of today’s cost. An agent can get an isolated database instantly, without requiring a dedicated machine for every workload.

For existing users, nothing changes. Supabase will continue building around Postgres, while Turso will continue its work on SQLite. Together, we’re creating something new that will bring the Supabase experience to every agent.

There’s a lot that brought our teams together: open source, developer experience, and a willingness to tackle hard infrastructure problems. We’re excited to welcome Glauber Costa , Pekka Enberg, and the entire Turso team to Supabase, with Glauber joining as Head of Agentic Services.

Thank you to GIC, CapitalG, IronArc, SquarePeg, and everyone who continues to support us. Most importantly, thank you to the Supabase community. You keep building faster than we expect, which means we have to keep doing the same.

Sri Muppidi has more on the news for the New York Times and we’ve shared more on the Supabase blog. Links in the comments.
